baseline_models.focus_anchor: بَاخِعٌ نَفْسَكَ عَلَى آثَارِهِمْ ... إِن لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوا ... أَسَفًا
baseline_models.mechanism: Failed heart-assent to a renewed report becomes spatial pursuit: the addressees recede into tracks, the reader keeps following, and grief over what escaped feeds back until it consumes the life doing the following.

activation_trace.role: Killing the self through grief supplies the feedback loop's lethal endpoint.
The life-bearing self is the finite resource endangered by the pursuit.
Following behind a predecessor's track turns failed reception into continued pursuit after departure.
Heart-settled assent is the missing response that starts the loop.
A report renewed in speech is the object whose reception remains unsettled.
Intense sorrow over what has escaped supplies the pursuit's affective force.

changed_reading.before: You may kill yourself from sorrow because they do not believe.
changed_reading.after: Their nonreception is pictured as a receding trail that the addressee keeps pursuing until grief consumes the very life engaged in pursuit.

baseline_models.mechanism: The effort root includes both reaching one's utmost and exhausting soil by repeated cultivation; paired with a discourse seeking a new state and an asaf branch of failed growth, the self becomes the resource depleted by trying to cultivate reception past its limit.

activation_trace.role: Utmost exertion, including soil exhausted by overcultivation, supplies the depletion mechanism.
The self as the whole entity locates where the depletion is borne.
Coming to be after nonexistence supplies the hoped-for emergence that the discourse is made to cultivate.
Failure of growth supplies the barren result of excessive cultivation.

changed_reading.before: The verse restrains an excess of emotion.
changed_reading.after: It also restrains an impossible cultivation project: trying to make belief grow can work the speaker's own self into barrenness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: عَلَى آثَارِهِمْ ... لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوا بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ
baseline_models.mechanism: The trace root can name a transmitted report while hadith names speech continually made new. Their juxtaposition makes nonbelief a broken handoff: living discourse fails to become a trusted, carried report among its present hearers.

activation_trace.role: A report carried until it becomes transmitted supplies the downstream side of the handoff.
Speech renewed as report supplies the live upstream side of the handoff.
Trusted assent is the transfer condition that fails.
Utmost exertion marks the speaker's attempt to bridge the failed transfer.
Sorrow over a missed outcome makes the failed handoff personally costly.

changed_reading.before: The speaker grieves because a message is rejected.
changed_reading.after: The speaker grieves at a failed transmission threshold: a living report is heard but does not become trusted testimony carried by these hearers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening contrast between an undistorted written composition and an unsupported mouth-word makes the focus failure more precise: the issue is not lack of verbal output but refusal of a report that corrects a speech circuit detached from knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Renewed report is the corrective communicative event whose reception is at issue.
Trusted assent distinguishes reception from merely producing or hearing words.
Ordered letters and the written object supply the composed side of the contrast.
Deviation in meaning supplies the distortion explicitly denied of that composition.
Knowledge as disclosure is explicitly absent from the rival assertion.
Intelligible speech linking speakers supplies the mouth-word channel that can still carry falsehood.
Falsehood supplies the failed epistemic quality of the preceding speech circuit.

structural_cues: 18:1-5 place a straight written object and an unsupported mouth-word immediately before the conditional grief of 18:6.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies composed straightness versus knowledge-less false speech; I infer that nonbelief marks a trust failure rather than a shortage of words, while the live alternative is that hadith simply names the scripture without a medium contrast.

changed_reading.before: Their refusal is generic rejection of a message.
changed_reading.after: Their refusal continues a contrast between composed corrective discourse and inherited mouth-speech that circulates without disclosed knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate earth sequence turns the cultivation baseline into a full cycle: a decorated field exposes work under test, then becomes vegetationless ground. The addressee is warned not to take over that test by overworking his own self as though he must force the crop of belief.

activation_trace.role: Exhaustion through utmost effort, including overworked soil, anchors the self-cultivation analogy.
Failed growth gives grief a barren-ground edge.
Testing that makes a condition manifest assigns evaluation of the field rather than control of its yield.
Purposive work supplies what the decorated field is testing.
Ground cut off from vegetation supplies the cycle's terminal barren state.

structural_cues: 18:7-8 immediately recast surface adornment as a test of work and then as vegetationless ground.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a test field, evaluated work, and a barren ending alongside focus branches of overcultivation and failed growth; I infer an effort-to-depletion arrow, while the live alternative is that the earth sequence only relativizes worldly grief without mapping the self as soil.

changed_reading.before: The addressee is simply too sorrowful about rejection.
changed_reading.after: The addressee is in danger of treating another's belief as his crop, overcultivating until the worker himself becomes the barren field.

context_deltas.mechanism: The cave account converts marks into trustworthy narration: inscription or record is followed by a sequentially carried report, named as true news, whose subjects themselves enact the belief missing in 18:6. The focus phrase becomes a threshold where following traces can become disciplined telling rather than endless private pursuit.

activation_trace.role: A report carried until it becomes transmitted anchors the trace-to-narration conversion.
Renewed speech supplies the live form into which traces are narratively converted.
A marked line in a book or register supplies the account's inscription pole.
Carrying a report in sequence supplies the method that orders the traces.
News that arrives and is conveyed supplies the packet's explicit report event.
Stable correspondence with reality qualifies the report as true.
The youths' heart-assent realizes within the account the response absent in the focus condition.

structural_cues: 18:9-13 move from record, sign, and counting into a sequentially told true report whose subjects believe.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inscription, ordered telling, true news, and believing subjects; I infer that traces are being converted into warranted testimony, while the live alternative is that آثار in 18:6 remains only the physical wake of departing people.

changed_reading.before: Following their traces is only chasing people who have turned away.
changed_reading.after: At the narrative threshold, following traces can be redirected from consuming pursuit into the disciplined production of true, transmissible testimony.

context_deltas.mechanism: Belief's endurance is shown as externally increased, hearts are bound firm, mercy is spread, and circumstances are prepared. This relocates causation: the addressee bears witness and tells, but cannot substitute his own spent life for the agency that stabilizes believing hearts.

activation_trace.role: Self-killing grief is the misplaced causal expenditure being checked.
The speaker's finite life is what cannot be exchanged for another heart's assent.
Heart-assent is the outcome whose causal ownership is clarified.
Increase and growth supply guidance as an added outcome rather than self-production.
Binding the heart into firmness supplies the stabilizing action absent from human persuasion.
Opening and spreading supplies mercy as an enabling environment.
Preparation and setting-right supply circumstances made ready for the believers.

structural_cues: 18:13-16 repeatedly assign increased guidance, heart-strengthening, opened mercy, and prepared circumstances to an agency beyond the youths.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies belief followed by added guidance, heart-binding, mercy, and preparation; I infer that stable reception is enabled rather than manufactured by the grieving speaker, while the live alternative is that these actions describe the youths alone and establish no general causal boundary.

changed_reading.before: Enough personal intensity might make up for their failure to believe.
changed_reading.after: The speaker's life cannot function as causal payment for another's assent; the surrounding account locates heart-firmness and enabling conditions elsewhere.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sleepers look awake, yet are asleep and repeatedly turned. This weakens any inference that visible residue or present posture discloses a person's final state: traces remain evidence, but not exhaustive knowledge warranting terminal grief.

activation_trace.role: A remaining mark that indicates what was supplies the visible evidence whose reach is being limited.
Calculation or supposition supplies the observer's mistaken inference from appearance.
Wakefulness supplies the apparent state.
Sleep and stillness supply the concealed actual state.
Turning a thing from one face to another makes state-management itself an inversion mechanism.

structural_cues: 18:17-18 place guided spatial turning beside an explicit opposition between what an observer calculates and the sleepers' actual condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an appearance-to-supposition error and repeated turning; I infer that visible traces cannot authorize a final verdict on reception, while the live alternative is that this epistemic reversal is cave-specific and does not qualify the explicit nonbelief in 18:6.

changed_reading.before: Their receding traces certify an accomplished and final loss.
changed_reading.after: Their traces register present departure, but the following narrative warns that visible states can invert reality, so grief must not harden a condition into final knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later threat of being forced back into a community creed distinguishes coerced affiliation from heart-settled trust. The coercive branch of b-kh then acts as a warning: neither pressure on them nor pressure turned inward on the speaker can manufacture the belief whose absence hurts.

activation_trace.role: Acknowledgment or submission under coercion supplies the false substitute for belief.
Inner stillness in security and trust supplies the noncoercive quality of genuine assent.
Return after departure supplies the forced reversal imposed on the youths.
A creed followed as a communal way supplies what they would be forced to rejoin.
Success and lasting survival supply the outcome that coercive return would permanently destroy.

structural_cues: 18:20 makes return to the community's creed an outcome imposed under discovery and threat, not an inwardly chosen assent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forced return to a creed and permanent failure; I infer that coerced conformity cannot answer the focus ayah's trust-root, while the live alternative is that 18:20 concerns apostasy under duress rather than a general contrast between persuasion and coercion.

changed_reading.before: Nonbelief is a deficit that greater pressure might overcome.
changed_reading.after: The pericope distinguishes heart-settled trust from forced creed-membership, so self-destruction cannot serve as an ethical proxy for producing assent.

context_deltas.mechanism: A true promise coexists with withheld numerical detail, conjecture about the unseen, and restricted disputation. Believing this report therefore does not mean possessing or forcing closure on every detail; exhaustive argumentative labor would violate the discourse's own epistemic shape.

activation_trace.role: The renewed report is the discourse whose truth can include disciplined incompleteness.
Utmost exertion supplies the argumentative overwork now bounded by the report itself.
Truth stably corresponding to reality secures the account's central claim.
Speaking by conjecture about the unseen marks an explicitly unreliable route to detail.
Concealment from sight supplies the domain that remains unavailable.
Sharp verbal disputation supplies the labor the reader is told to restrict.

structural_cues: 18:21-22 affirm the promise's truth while withholding the sleepers' count and limiting both dispute and consultation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a true core claim beside inaccessible detail and curtailed controversy; I infer that assent need not equal total closure, while the live alternative is that the restraint applies only to the sleepers' number and not to the grief over broader nonbelief.

changed_reading.before: Successful reception would require securing assent and explanatory closure across the whole report.
changed_reading.after: The report models bounded truth: its central claim can be trusted while some details remain unseen and argument is deliberately left incomplete.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speaker must condition even his own future act, seek guidance rather than own it, and end with judgment that admits no partner. If his own tomorrow is not autonomously guaranteed, another person's present assent cannot coherently be treated as an outcome purchased by spending his self.

activation_trace.role: The threatened expenditure of life supplies the impossible price for causal control.
The self's intention and deliberation locate the agency whose limits are exposed.
Another heart's assent is the outcome the speaker cannot own.
Will directed toward a thing supplies the contingency placed over future assertion.
Bringing about an act supplies the speaker's own promised action, which is not autonomous.
Gentle direction to the right way supplies guidance as something received and sought.
Partnership supplies the co-ownership explicitly denied in judgment.
Judgment between people locates final adjudication beyond the grieving speaker.

structural_cues: 18:23-26 successively qualify future assertion, redirect the speaker toward sought guidance, and deny partnership in final judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contingent future action, requested guidance, and unshared judgment; I infer a common boundary on the speaker's causal ownership of reception, while the live alternative is that these are separate instructions with no backward bearing on 18:6.

changed_reading.before: The intensity of the speaker's agency could compensate for another's refusal.
changed_reading.after: The speaker is responsible for truthful telling and seeking guidance, not for owning another heart's response or sharing final judgment over it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates hadith's material polishing branch rather than its ordinary speech branch. It remains anchored in the focus discourse, exhaustive effort, and self-interiority, while 18:14 supplies the heart explicitly; render it as an exploratory process metaphor, not as the lexical replacement for hadith.

activation_trace.role: Polishing a heart through admonition supplies an abrasive model of what renewed discourse can do.
Exhaustive exertion supplies the excessive pressure applied when polishing seems not to take.
The self's inward faculty supplies the surface onto which failed outward labor rebounds.
The heart as inward organ supplies the explicit context anchor for the polishing image.

changed_reading.before: The hadith is information that the hearers decline to credit.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the hadith is also a heart-polishing event; when it does not visibly polish them, the speaker risks turning the abrasive labor back onto his own interior.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links the rejecters' receding traces to the later hypothetical viewer's flight from the sleepers. It remains anchored in آثارهم and asaf's anger shade, with explicit flight and fear branches in 18:18; render it as a sequence-level reversal of motion and affect, not as an identification of the two groups.

activation_trace.role: Following behind those who have gone supplies the initial pursuit direction.
Grief inflected with anger supplies an affect more unstable than sorrow alone.
Flight and escape reverse the earlier direction of pursuit around a believing group.
Fear and alarm supply the later affect that drives the reversed motion.

changed_reading.before: The messenger follows departing rejecters while grief remains entirely on his side.
changed_reading.after: The sequence later reverses the vector: an outsider flees the believing sleepers in fear, making pursuit, withdrawal, grief, and alarm exchange positions across the pericope.

strongest_changes: The earth-test sequence activates b-kh as overcultivation: trying to grow another's belief can leave the speaker himself barren.
The cave account redirects traces into inscription, ordered report, and true testimony rather than endless pursuit after departing hearers.
Heart-binding, guidance, and prepared refuge relocate the causation of durable belief beyond the speaker's expenditure of self.
Withheld detail, contingent future action, and unshared judgment bound what the speaker must know, accomplish, and control.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah became a hinge among three mechanisms usually collapsed into sorrow: a pursuit feedback loop, a depleted cultivation project, and a failed transmission handoff. The context then redirected each mechanism toward bounded testimony rather than self-erasure.
remaining_uncertainties: The cultivation reading is branch-backed and strongly echoed by 18:7-8, but remains a material analogy rather than a necessary lexical reading.
The appearance reversal in 18:17-18 may limit inference from traces generally, or may remain local to the sleepers' exceptional state.
The anger branch of asaf and the heart-polishing branch of hadith are live exploratory shades, not grounds for displacing the dominant grief and speech senses.
